mapper.select:
select date_format(`bc`.`active_date`, '%Y-%m-%d') as `activeDate`, (select `abbreviation` from `base_organization` where `org_id` = `bc`.`active_org_id`) as `activeOrgName`, `bc`.`card_number`, (select `name` from `base_patient` where `patient_id` = `bc`.`patient_id`) as `cardOwner`, `bc`.`sold_target`, `bc`.`sold_phone_number`, `bc`.`sale_channel_name`, (select `employee_name` from `base_employee` where `user_id` = `bc`.`active_user_id`) as `activeUser` from `base_card` `bc` inner join `base_coupon` `b` on `b`.`coupon_id` = `bc`.`coupon_id` where `bc`.`coupon_id` = #{couponId} and `b`.`coupon_type` != 4 and `bc`.`status` in (2,3,4) and `bc`.`allocate_org_id` = 0
and `bc`.`card_number` like concat('%', #{cardNumber}, '%')
and `bc`.`sold_target` like concat('%', #{soldTarget}, '%')
and `bc`.`sale_channel_id` in
#{item}
and (`bc`.`active_date` >= #{activeStartDate} and `bc`.`active_date` < #{activeStartDate})
and `bc`.`active_org_id` in
#{item}
order by `bc`.`active_date` desc

select date_format(`bc`.`sold_date`, '%Y-%m-%d') as `soldDate`, `bc`.`sold_target`, `bc`.`sold_phone_number`, `b`.`coupon_name`, `b`.`coupon_type`, `bc`.`card_number`, `b`.`sold_amount`, `bc`.`sold_type`, `bc`.`charge_status`, `bc`.`pay_name` from `base_card` `bc` inner join `base_coupon` `b` on `b`.`coupon_id` = `bc`.`coupon_id` where `bc`.`status` != 0 and `bc`.`allocate_org_id` != 0
and `bc`.`allocate_org_id` = #{orgId}
and (`bc`.`sold_date` >= #{soldStartDate} and `bc`.`sold_date` < #{soldEndDate})
and `b`.`coupon_name` like concat('%', #{couponName}, '%')
and `bc`.`card_number` like concat('%', #{cardNumber}, '%')
and `bc`.`sold_target` like concat('%', #{soldTarget}, '%')
and `bc`.`sold_phone_number` like concat('%', #{soldPhoneNumber}, '%')
and `b`.`coupon_type` in
#{item}
order by `bc`.`sold_date` desc

select `bc`.`card_number`, `bo`.`abbreviation` as `rechargeOrgName`, date_format(`bc`.`active_date`, '%Y-%m-%d') as `rechargeDate`, `bp`.`name` as `patientName`, `bp`.`mobile` as `patientMobile`, `bpm`.`card_number` as `rechargeAccount`, `b`.`sold_amount` as `rechargeAmount`, `b`.`bonus` as `rechargeBonus`, `be`.`employee_name` as `rechargeUser` from `base_card` `bc` inner join `base_coupon` `b` on `b`.`coupon_id` = `bc`.`coupon_id` inner join `base_patient` `bp` on `bp`.`patient_id` = `bc`.`patient_id` inner join `base_patient_member` `bpm` on `bpm`.`patient_id` = `bc`.`patient_id` and `bpm`.type = 1 inner join `base_organization` `bo` on `bo`.`org_id` = `bc`.`active_org_id` inner join `base_employee` `be` on `be`.`user_id` = `bc`.`active_user_id` where `bc`.`coupon_id` = #{couponId} and `bc`.`status` = 4
and `bc`.`card_number` like concat('%', #{cardNumber}, '%')
and (`bp`.`name` like concat('%', #{patientKeyWord}, '%') or `bp`.`mobile` like concat('%', #{patientKeyWord}, '%') or `bp`.`pinyin_name` like concat('%', #{patientKeyWord}, '%'))
and `bc`.`active_org_id` in
#{item}
and `bpm`.`card_number` like concat('%', #{rechargeAccount}, '%')
and (`bc`.`active_date` >= #{rechargeStartDate} and `bc`.`active_date` < #{rechargeEndDate})
order by `bc`.`active_date` desc
